heading_en: Terms Used in the Sensitivities-Based Method
summary_ja: この節で用いるリスク・クラス（七区分）及びコリレーション・トレーディング・ポートフォリオの用語の意義を定める。
summary_en: Defines the terms "risk class" (seven categories) and "correlation trading portfolio" used in this Section.
paragraphs: In this Section, the meanings of the terms set out in the following items are as provided in those items. (i) Risk class: the following categories: (a) General interest rate risk; (b) Credit spread risk (limited to that relating to non-securitization products); (c) Credit spread risk (limited to that relating to securitization products that are in the non-correlation trading portfolio (hereinafter in this Section referred to as "securitization products (non-CTP)")); (d) Credit spread risk (limited to that relating to securitization products that are in the correlation trading portfolio (hereinafter in this Section referred to as "securitization products (CTP)")); (e) Equity risk; (f) Commodity risk; (g) Foreign exchange risk; (ii) Correlation trading portfolio: the following positions: (a) Securitization product positions that satisfy all of the following requirements: (1) They are correlation trading (excluding derivative transactions relating to securitization product exposures that do not provide a proportional share of the amounts received on a tranche of a securitization product); (2) They do not refer to underlying assets relating to the exposures provided for in Articles 34 through 37-2; (3) They do not refer to claims on securitization special-purpose conduits; (b) Positions that do not fall under securitization products (hereinafter in this Section referred to as "non-securitization products") and that are intended to hedge the positions set out in (a).
